captions.detailed: This 3D model features a magnifying work lamp with a heavy, circular black base. A two-segment articulated arm constructed from dual parallel silver rods connects the base to a large circular light-ring head. The head houses a central translucent blue magnifying glass lens, and the entire structure is fully adjustable via pitch-axis revolute joints at the base, elbow, and lamp head connection point.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated magnifying work lamp with a wide, circular black base, a dual-rod silver metal arm with adjustable shoulder and elbow joints, and a circular beige ring shade holding a transparent blue glass lens with a pivoting joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs the lamp using an ArticulatedObject builder. The base is created using a flat cylinder and a small upright block. The lower and upper arm segments are modeled as pairs of parallel cylinders offset laterally. The elbow joint is constructed with a transverse cylinder representing the tightening knob. The lamp head is formed by a hollow ring (subtraction of two cylinders) holding a thin disc for the lens, connected to the upper arm via a small pivoting bracket. Revolute joints are defined at the shoulder, elbow, and head tilt axes using appropriate limits.
